summary_en: STrust authorized acquisition of up to 100,000 shares (1.6% of outstanding shares) for a maximum of 130 million yen between October 15, 2026 and February 28, 2027, to secure shares for future delivery under its restricted stock award program for executive directors.
title_en: Notice of Determination of Matters Concerning Acquisition of Treasury Stock (Acquisition of Treasury Stock Based on Articles of Incorporation Pursuant to Article 165, Paragraph 2 of the Companies Act)
translation_en_brief:
STrust Co., Ltd. has authorized the acquisition of treasury shares to support its restricted stock award program for executive directors (excluding audit and supervisory committee members). The acquisition will be conducted at the board's discretion, with a maximum of 100,000 shares to be purchased for up to 130 million yen between October 15, 2026 and February 28, 2027, representing 1.6% of outstanding shares excluding treasury stock (6,090,684 shares as of October 14, 2026).

The company states that the primary purpose is to secure shares for future delivery under the restricted stock award program while limiting dilution to existing shareholders. The restricted stock award program is designed to align management incentives with stock price performance and company value enhancement. Shares acquired under this authorization will be allocated exclusively to satisfy obligations under the award program.

The acquisition will be executed through the market purchase method and/or block trading arrangements. The authorization is provided under Article 165, Paragraph 2 of the Companies Act, which permits companies to repurchase shares based on provisions in their articles of incorporation.
